visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Size the Array to Fit
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A fixed array of 100 ints is declared for 4 values. Allocate exactly n ints with malloc and free them at the end. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A fixed array wastes memory when n is small and overflows when n is large. Allocating n elements uses exactly what is needed, as long as every malloc is paired with a free.
